sources.title: Ambient conditions during three Bon Secour Bay deployments
sources.use: site/trace-specific cadence sensitivity only
sources.reported_details: Three publisher-hash-matched files yielded 741, 728 and 748 regular two-minute readings. Worst-case point-sample minimum inflation was 0.05/0.02/0.04 mg/L at five minutes and 0.16/0.10/0.07 mg/L at 15 minutes, with maximum minimum-time shifts of 4/2/4 and 40/12/80 minutes respectively.
sources.guardrail: Fixed-bin averaging is a separate result. Neither method proves fidelity to the published transient. Raw/merged deployment-1 clocks indicate August 5-6, 2021 while the paper describes August 7-8; infer no correction or external join. Not a Jubilee threshold or cadence decision.
